focus: service-bound symmetric sender-possession ingress gate plus authenticated-context validation refactor
limits: symmetric HMAC proof is not asymmetric DPoP or certificate-bound access token verification
no sender proof replay cache beyond the existing reservation/JWT/effect replay semantics
operator config remains local digest-pinned JSON, not signed control plane
security_boundary: service config owns caller binding secret id and HMAC secret
request carries only sender_possession proof material
bad/missing proof fails before profile adapter or SQLite append
proof binds service id, service config digest, profile digest, request id, handle, authenticator, principal, transport flag, and canonical case digest
